transitions.name: epic-child-checkbox-projection
transitions.source: Related children read by real syncEpic adapter; current parent body read immediately before update.
transitions.event: syncEpic({id}) invoked directly, by board-transition, apply audit or post-merge resume; parent and sibling ids from native relations.
transitions.predecessor: Related-child closed boolean, not an approved workflow ledger record. Closed=false cannot produce a checked row.
transitions.nextState: Matching checkbox reflects closed; absent child appended once; successful write read back before confirmation.
transitions.forbidden: Absent parent returns parent-absent; no-op transport returns unconfirmed read-back error; non-checkbox prose and prefix-colliding ids cannot substitute for a child entry.; filesystem permission denial returns epic-sync-failed and preserves parent; description/URL mentions cannot identify target; empty relation set makes no body change.
transitions.replay: Pure function byte-idempotence; fresh adapter instance and CLI restart perform no additional epic change.
transitions.staleWriter: No version/epoch exists in this projection API; concurrency protocol is not changed or claimed. Ledger/head/batch negative families explicitly N/A in matrix.
transitions.terminalPreconditions: Related-child state is authoritative; this group never merges/reopens a card or assigns a parent.
transitions.metrics: No metric write in this owner; telemetry integration remains blocking carried finding r0-6.
